characteristics.roast: Double pan-firing with final charcoal baking
characteristics.harvestSeason: Mid-spring (harvested later than most green teas, once leaves have fully opened)

description.short: Unique green tea made without buds or stems — single open leaves shaped like melon seeds
description.overview: The only variety of Chinese green tea where buds and petioles (stems) are deliberately removed, using exclusively the mature leaf blades. This gives it a singular appearance, texture, and rich taste profile.
description.leaf: Individual flat leaf blades devoid of buds and stems, deep emerald green with gently curved edges resembling melon seeds
description.liquor: Rich, clear green-yellow liquor, denser than typical green teas
description.aroma: Fresh, grassy, with faint toasty warmth from charcoal baking
description.taste: Full-bodied, gently brisk, with roasted nut undertones and a rich savory finish
description.aftertaste: Medium-long, clean, with subtle dryness and sweetness
description.processing: Plucking of mature 2nd and 3rd leaves (excluding the bud) → manual de-stemming to isolate leaf blades → two-stage wok fixation → final charcoal baking in specialized bamboo baskets (laohuo / longhong)

history.origin: The name means 'Lu'an Melon Seed' — describing the distinctive curved silhouette of the processed leaf blade
history.development: Uniquely, producers intentionally discard the bud, deeming it less flavor-rich than mature leaves — an unusual practice in Chinese tea culture where buds are conventionally prized
history.modern: Historically celebrated as an imperial tribute tea during the Ming and Qing dynasties; today protected as a national geographical indication product and one of China's Ten Famous Teas
interestingFacts: The final charcoal baking in specialized bamboo baskets over open coals is a unique technique for green tea, more reminiscent of charcoal-roasted oolongs
Because it contains no buds, the tea looks very different from typical high-grade green teas, sometimes surprising newcomers who expect tender downy shoots
